nodes.name: Send message and wait for response

parameters.message:
={{ (() => { const r = $('Validate Review Request').first().json; const review = $('MIRA_Document_Reviews').first().json; const response = $('Send message and wait for response').first().json.data ?? {}; const esc = value => String(value ?? '') .replace(/&/g, '&') .replace(//g, '>') .replace(/"/g, '"') .replace(/'/g, '''); const reviewId = review.review_id ?? r.review_id ?? 'N/A'; const comments = String( response.Reviewer_comments ?? '' ).trim(); const commentsHtml = comments ? `

Reviewer Comments

${esc(comments).replace(/\r?\n/g, '
')}
` : ''; // Use the approved PDF export if it provides a valid URL. const exported = $('Export Approved PDF').first().json; const fileUrl = String( exported.webViewLink ?? exported.file_url ?? r.file_url ?? '' ).trim(); const reportLink = /^https:\/\/[^\s]+$/i.test(fileUrl) ? `

View Approved Report

` : `

The approved project report is attached to this email in PDF format for your reference.

`; return `

MIRA – Project Intelligence

Report Approved

Hello,

The Mira project report has completed human review and has been APPROVED.

Project ${esc(r.project_name)}
Version ${esc(r.document_version ?? '1.0')}
Review ID ${esc(reviewId)}
Status Approved
${commentsHtml}

Approved Document

The approved report has been processed through Mira's human-in-the-loop review workflow.

${reportLink}

Governance Note

Approval applies only to this report version and Review ID. Approval does not automatically authorize external distribution.

Thank you,
Mira Project Intelligence Assistant

`; })() }}
